subject: REFUSAL-CENSUS landed 9af3c68 — replica mill, unobserved ≠ 0%, trainer-caller list pinned
body:
SHA 9af3c68 on hermes/2026-09-18-queues.

WHAT IT IS. Pure mill packages/prediction-engine/src/edge-lab/refusal-census.ts plus CLI run-refusal-census.ts. CI runs --rows. Whoever has a replica runs READONLY_DATABASE_URL + psql. This sandbox never opened a database.

OUTPUT. refusals per (family, reason, sport, week). inputCoverage.unobservedFamilies so a replica extract that cannot see CQR/JK+/IVAP/conformal/devig reports those families as unobserved, not as a 0% rate. Empty replica extract exits 2: 'that is not a 0% refusal rate; it is an empty extract'.

REPLICA SQL COVERS. trueprob_basis, independent_edge_pass, adverse_edge, published_pass, gate_gated. Tables: picks JOIN games JOIN sports, LATERAL latest gate_decisions. mergedIntoGameId IS NULL.

NOT PERSISTED TODAY, NAMED. cqr.licensed, jackknifePlus.licensed / refusedBound, ivap.width, conformal.licensed, devig-ok. Missing input is a shadow_math_refusals table or those flags on the pick row. --needs prints the contract. jackknifeRefusedBound is counted when attached (none|lower|upper|both); Jackknife+ itself does not yet emit the field — that is unit 4 plus the field you handed over.

CALLER LIST, MEASURED, OPUS CORRECTION ACCEPTED. tryReadTrainableTrueProb: ranking-prob.ts:67 (production), trueprob-admission.ts:72 (mill), types tests. requireTrainableTrueProbBasis: types definition + types tests ONLY. 936be9c wired the ranking read; it did not wire the throwing form into any trainer. Comments in types/index.ts, backfill-independent-trueprob.ts, quarantine-backfill-independent-edge.ts no longer claim otherwise.

CI. 11/11 refusal-census tests. prediction-engine tsc clean. types trueprob-basis 6/6.

NEXT. Unit 2 MARKET-5PP: state the estimand in one line before computing. Mill already exists. Do not carry an unmeasured 5% as established.
